title: Pumpkin Patch in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Only one real cut-your-own harvest inside Berlin:** the Erntefest at **Domäne Dahlem on Saturday 3 and Sunday 4 October**, 10:00 to 18:00, harvesting until 17:00. Entry €4.50, under 12 free.
**Most "pumpkin patches" are pumpkin shows.** You choose from the display and pay by weight, as at **Späth in Baumschulenweg** (free, about 100 varieties, until early November).
**The big day out is Klaistow near Beelitz:** more than 100,000 pumpkins, **€6 at weekends**, daily 9:00 to 18:00 until 15 November, carving on 26 to 27 September and 3 to 4 October.
**Free and inside ABC:** Karls in Elstal until 1 November. **Festival days:** Kremmen on 17 and 18 October, Fredersdorf on Saturday 24 October from 15:00 with a bonfire.
**Check your ticket zone.** Dahlem and Späth are AB, Elstal and Fredersdorf ABC. Klaistow and Kremmen are outside ABC, so take the Deutschlandticket.
**Bring cash** for field tills and village festivals, and a sturdy bag for the ride home.
